title: Product Along a Permutation
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $R$ be a commutative semiring, let $A$ be a Boolean matrix indexed by $\text{Fin}(n)\times\text{Fin}(n)$, and let $\sigma$ be a permutation of $\text{Fin}(n)$. The product over $i\in\text{Fin}(n)$ of the entries of the Edmonds matrix in positions $(i,\sigma(i))$ equals the monomial with coefficient $1$ and exponent vector having exponent $1$ at each pair $(i,\sigma(i))$ if every such entry of $A$ is true, and equals zero otherwise.
